title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-jdu2: libnull.rlib tracked as build artifact at repo root
description:
Commit 23d0bb18d5 (project-LICHEN-2auf.52: fix) includes libnull.rlib, a compiled .rlib archive tracked at the repo root. Build artifacts must never be in version control.
- The new rust/.gitignore (HEAD) covers rust/*.rlib but not root-level *.rlib
- Remove libnull.rlib from git tracking
- Add *.rlib to root .gitignore or, if no root .gitignore exists, consider whether libnull.rlib should have been in rust/ or removed entirely
